brief: Holds a timer in pure Ring that calls a function every interval, or once, advanced by a timer manager's loop.
detail: The same contract as stzReactiveTimer, with an owner object kept for the caller: CheckAndTick fires the function when the interval has passed since the last firing on the engine's clock, answers 1 while the timer stays active and 0 when it is stopped or has just fired as a one-shot. It decides whether to stop a one-shot before it calls the function, because the function may stop the whole timer system.
receiver:
$nFired = 0
o1 = new stzRingTimer("once", 20, func { $nFired++ }, new stzReactive(), 1, "")
